description: This file contains unit tests for the BasketWithItemsSpecification class, verifying its behavior with different basket IDs and buyer IDs, using mocking with NSubstitute and test assertions with xUnit.

classes.name: BasketWithItems
classes.description: Unit test class for BasketWithItemsSpecification, testing matching logic based on basket IDs and buyer IDs.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBasketId
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly matches a basket with a specified basket ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBasketIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that the specification does not match any basket if the basket ID isn't present.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBuyerId
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly matches a basket with a specified buyer ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBuyerIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that the specification does not match any basket if the buyer ID isn't present.

methods.name: GetTestBasketCollection
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of mocked Basket objects for testing purposes.
